name: SEI Inc

nadir.desc: The property consists of a large multi-story commercial building with a complex gray shingle roof, multiple gables, and a prominent tower feature|Green lawn and landscaping surround the building on all sides|Sidewalks and street frontage border the property|Vehicles are parked along the adjacent street|Paved access areas are present on one side of the building.

alpha.desc: The front of the building shows a multi-story light-colored structure with a wrap-around porch and a prominent corner tower|Multiple vehicles are parked along the street in front of the property|Landscaped lawn and shrubs extend from the building to the sidewalk|A retaining wall separates the lawn from the public sidewalk|Signage is visible near the main entrance area.

bravo.desc: The left side of the building shows the side with the tower and complex roofline|The wrap-around porch continues along this side|Landscaped lawn and shrubs are present|Vehicles are parked along the adjacent street|A retaining wall separates the lawn from the public sidewalk|Sidewalk and street frontage run along the property edge.

charlie.desc: The rear of the building shows the back and side of the multi-story structure|The tower is visible from this angle|Green lawn and landscaping extend around the building|Paved areas and access points are present on one side|The property is bordered by streets on multiple sides.

delta.desc: The right side of the building shows the side with the tower, porch, and multi-story facade|Landscaped lawn and shrubs fill the front and side yard areas|Vehicles are parked along the front street|A retaining wall separates the lawn from the public sidewalk|Sidewalk and street frontage border the property|The main entrance area is visible toward the front.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from the adjacent streets with on-street parking along the front and sides of the property. The building occupies a corner or near-corner lot with sidewalks on multiple sides. A wrap-around porch provides elevated entry points. The multi-story structure includes a prominent tower feature and complex roofline. Green lawn and landscaping surround the building. Paved access areas exist on at least one side. The property is located in a mixed commercial and residential area with neighboring businesses and homes nearby.
clarifications: Where is the primary public entrance into the building, and is it accessible from the wrap-around porch? Are there designated off-street parking or loading areas on the property, or is access limited to street parking? Is there a secondary or rear entrance for staff or emergency use? Does the tower contain accessible interior space or serve only as an architectural feature? Are any gates or barriers present that could restrict vehicle or pedestrian movement around the building?
